name: intent-card
mathml:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" data-latex="\card{S}">
  <mrow intent="cardinality($a)" ext-intent="cardinality($a)" ext-arity="1" ext-open="the cardinality of" ext-close="" data-latex="\intent{cardinality}{\left|\iarg{S}\right|}">
    <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER" data-latex="\left|\iarg{S}\right|">
      <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN" data-latex="\left|">|</mo>
      <mi data-latex="\iarg{S}" arg="a" ext-argname="a">S</mi>
      <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE" data-latex="\right|">|</mo>
    </mrow>
  </mrow>
</math>

name: intent-norm
mathml:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" data-latex="\norm{v}">
  <mrow intent="norm($a)" ext-intent="norm($a)" ext-arity="1" ext-open="the norm of" ext-close="" data-latex="\intent{norm}{\left\|\iarg{v}\right\|}">
    <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER" data-latex="\left\|\iarg{v}\right\|">
      <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN" data-latex="\left\|">‖</mo>
      <mi data-latex="\iarg{v}" arg="a" ext-argname="a">v</mi>
      <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE" data-latex="\right\|">‖</mo>
    </mrow>
  </mrow>
</math>

name: intent-openint
mathml:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" data-latex="\openint{a}{b}">
  <mrow intent="open-interval($a,$b)" ext-intent="open-interval($a,$b)" ext-arity="2" ext-open="the open interval from" ext-close="" ext-mid1="to" data-latex="\intent{open-interval}{\left(\iarg{a},\iarg[b]{b}\right)}">
    <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER" data-latex="\left(\iarg{a},\iarg[b]{b}\right)">
      <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN" data-latex="\left(">(</mo>
      <mi data-latex="\iarg{a}" arg="a" ext-argname="a">a</mi>
      <mo data-latex=",">,</mo>
      <mi data-latex="\iarg[b]{b}" arg="b" ext-argname="b">b</mi>
      <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE" data-latex="\right)">)</mo>
    </mrow>
  </mrow>
</math>

name: intent-closedint
mathml:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" data-latex="\closedint{a}{b}">
  <mrow intent="closed-interval($a,$b)" ext-intent="closed-interval($a,$b)" ext-arity="2" ext-open="the closed interval from" ext-close="" ext-mid1="to" data-latex="\intent{closed-interval}{\left[\iarg{a},\iarg[b]{b}\right]}">
    <mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER" data-latex="\left[\iarg{a},\iarg[b]{b}\right]">
      <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN" data-latex="\left[">[</mo>
      <mi data-latex="\iarg{a}" arg="a" ext-argname="a">a</mi>
      <mo data-latex=",">,</mo>
      <mi data-latex="\iarg[b]{b}" arg="b" ext-argname="b">b</mi>
      <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE" data-latex="\right]">]</mo>
    </mrow>
  </mrow>
</math>

name: intent-braket
mathml:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" data-latex="\braket{a}{b}">
  <mrow data-latex="{}">
    <mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN" stretchy="false">⟨</mo>
    <mi data-latex="a">a</mi>
    <mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE" stretchy="false">⟩</mo>
  </mrow>
  <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD" data-latex="{b}">
    <mi data-latex="b">b</mi>
  </mrow>
</math>

name: intent-ketbra
mathml:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" data-latex="\ketbra{a}{b}">
  <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD" data-latex="{\vert {a} \rangle\langle {b} \vert}">
    <mo data-mjx-texclass="ORD" fence="false" stretchy="false" data-latex="\vert">|</mo>
    <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD" data-latex="{a}">
      <mi data-latex="a">a</mi>
    </mrow>
    <mo fence="false" stretchy="false" data-latex="\rangle">⟩</mo>
    <mo fence="false" stretchy="false" data-latex="\langle">⟨</mo>
    <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD" data-latex="{b}">
      <mi data-latex="b">b</mi>
    </mrow>
    <mo data-mjx-texclass="ORD" fence="false" stretchy="false" data-latex="\vert">|</mo>
  </mrow>
</math>

name: intent-conj
mathml:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" data-latex="\conj{z}">
  <mrow intent="complex-conjugate($a)" ext-intent="complex-conjugate($a)" ext-arity="1" ext-open="the complex conjugate of" ext-close="" data-latex="\intent{complex-conjugate}{\overline{\iarg{z}}}">
    <mover data-latex="\overline{\iarg{z}}">
      <mi data-latex="\iarg{z}" arg="a" ext-argname="a">z</mi>
      <mo accent="true">―</mo>
    </mover>
  </mrow>
</math>

name: intent-transp
mathml:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" data-latex="\transp{A}">
  <mrow intent="transpose($a)" ext-intent="transpose($a)" ext-arity="1" ext-open="the transpose of" ext-close="" data-latex="\intent{transpose}{{\iarg{A}}^{\mathsf{T}}}">
    <msup data-latex="{\iarg{A}}^{\mathsf{T}}">
      <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD" data-latex="{\iarg{A}}">
        <mi data-latex="\iarg{A}" arg="a" ext-argname="a">A</mi>
      </mrow>
      <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD" data-latex="{\mathsf{T}}">
        <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD" data-latex="\mathsf{T}">
          <mi mathvariant="sans-serif" data-latex="T">T</mi>
        </mrow>
      </mrow>
    </msup>
  </mrow>
</math>

name: intent-ce-h2o
mathml:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" data-latex="\ce{H2O}">
  <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD" data-latex="\intentCeMark{{\mathrm{H}{\vphantom{A}}_{\smash[t]{2}}\mathrm{O}}}" data-chem="ce">
    <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD" data-latex="\mathrm{H}">
      <mi mathvariant="normal" data-latex="H">H</mi>
    </mrow>
    <msub data-latex="{\vphantom{A}}_{\smash[t]{2}}">
      <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD" data-latex="{\vphantom{A}}">
        <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD" data-latex="\vphantom{A}">
          <mpadded width="0">
            <mphantom>
              <mi data-latex="A">A</mi>
            </mphantom>
          </mpadded>
        </mrow>
      </mrow>
      <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD" data-latex="{\smash[t]{2}}">
        <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD" data-latex="\smash[t]{2}">
          <mpadded height="0">
            <mn data-latex="2">2</mn>
          </mpadded>
        </mrow>
      </mrow>
    </msub>
    <mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD" data-latex="\mathrm{O}">
      <mi mathvariant="normal" data-latex="O">O</mi>
    </mrow>
  </mrow>
</math>
